A lot goes into deciding what life safety equipment is needed to protect your people and your property. With so many options and multiple companies out there that provide these services, how do you choose? Silco has been voted Top Workplace 7 years running by our employees and we have an open checkbook when it comes to educating our people. Our technicians train and learn how to service the latest equipment, as well as the older systems that have been in service for decades. As a result, we have over 1,000 reviews on Google with an average of a 4.9 star rating from our customers, and we take pride in giving back to our local first responders, veterans, and people in need in our community. Because when quality comes first, trust follows. That’s why more than 45,000 customers across Ohio rely on Silco to install, inspect, repair, monitor, and maintain their life safety systems. When lives and property are on the line, quality matters. At Silco Fire & Security, quality is the standard behind everything we inspect, install, and service. It’s built into every step of our process—from system design and equipment selection to installation, inspection, and ongoing service. Every team member is accountable for the quality of their work because safety is a shared responsibility. Through continuous training, advanced technology, and rigorous internal standards, we go beyond code requirements to deliver systems our customers can trust when it matters most. Because quality isn’t about checking a box—it’s about protecting people, property, and the communities we serve. See how the Silco difference delivers quality and service you can trust.
